svg.title: Stock runway by functional stack

svg.text: Colour = stack · red bands = aggressive cut (12 wk) · green bands = lean bulk (6 mo) · phase bars burn only inside their window · date red=buy now, amber=this year, green=covered · 2026-06-21 → 2028-01-31
